modules.title: 输入模态和输出模态要分开看
不同模态分别负责什么

items.title: 模态就是信息形式
items.text: 文字、图片、音频和视频是常见模态，语音属于音频中的一种内容。多模态表示一个模型或系统能结合至少两种形式，不代表它一定支持全部形式。

items.title: 同一种模态可以出现在两边
items.text: 语音可以作为输入被转成文字，也可以作为输出把文字回答读出来。判断时要看它是交给 AI 的内容，还是 AI 返回的结果。

items.title: 能力要看具体模型和产品
items.text: 不同模型支持的输入、输出和文件类型不同，使用前要分别确认，不能从产品名称或一个上传按钮推断全部能力。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 界面能上传图片或音频，只能说明产品支持这种交互，不代表底层一定是原生多模态模型。无论内容由一个模型直接处理，还是由多个工具接力完成，识别和判断都可能出错，重要信息要回到原图、原音频或真实项目中核对。

lessonPractice.title: 你想让 AI 判断手机结账页里的付款按钮为什么看不见，怎样做最合适？

options.label: 附上当前截图，说明按钮本应出现的位置，请它区分画面能确认的线索和需要检查代码才能确认的原因
options.feedback: 对。图片提供当前画面，文字说明问题和判断边界。模型先分析可见线索；原因还要由你，或获得项目工具权限的 Agent，在真实项目中验证。

options.label: 只说“页面有问题，帮我修一下”，不提供截图或具体表现
options.feedback: 模型没有收到当前画面，也不知道哪里异常，只能猜测。多模态任务仍需要明确提供相关信息。

options.label: 只上传截图，并默认 AI 已经看见全部代码、隐藏状态和真实运行过程
options.feedback: 截图只包含画面中的像素，不会自动带上源代码、设备状态或运行数据。

en.title: You want AI to explain why the payment button is not visible on a mobile checkout page. What is the best approach?

options.label: Attach the current screenshot, say where the button should appear, and ask it to separate visible evidence from causes that require checking the code
options.feedback: Correct. The image supplies the current screen, while the text defines the question and its limits. The model can inspect visible clues first; you, or an agent with project-tool access, must then verify the cause in the real project.

options.label: Only say “the page is broken, fix it” without a screenshot or a specific symptom
options.feedback: The model has neither the current screen nor a clear symptom, so it can only guess. A multimodal task still needs relevant information.

options.label: Upload only the screenshot and assume the AI can now see all code, hidden state, and runtime behavior
options.feedback: A screenshot contains only visible pixels. It does not automatically include source code, device state, or runtime data.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 这张截图是手机上的结账页，付款按钮应该在底部，但现在看不见。先只根据截图告诉我你能确认的遮挡或布局线索，不能从画面确认的地方直接说不确定。然后再检查项目里的手机布局，找到原因后修改，并用同样的屏幕尺寸确认按钮能看到、能点击。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: This screenshot shows the checkout page on a phone. The payment button should be at the bottom, but it is not visible. First, use only the screenshot to identify any visible overlap or layout clues, and say when the image is not enough to confirm something. Then inspect the mobile layout in the project, fix the cause, and verify at the same screen size that the button is visible and clickable.

learning.assumes: You have sent text to AI and seen controls for uploading images, files, or recordings.
learning.outcome: You can separate input and output modes, decide what information to provide, and know what still needs verification.

modules.title: Separate input modes from output modes

items.title: A mode is a form of information
items.text: Text, images, audio, and video are common modes. Support for one does not mean support for all.

items.title: The same mode can be on either side
items.text: Audio can be input for transcription or output that reads an answer aloud.

items.title: Check the specific product
items.text: Supported inputs, outputs, and file types vary by model and product.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: An upload control shows product interaction support, not necessarily a native multimodal model. Verify important results against the original source or real project.
